g.text: Marie, do you have a moment?
Oui ! Pour toi, my wolf, anything. What is it ?
Oui ! Pour toi, my friend, anything. What is it ?
I'm trying to convince Roathe to help us reunite Loid and the Entrati family. But he's being stubborn about his taking the serum. I need your help in talking to him.
I'm trying to get Roathe to realize that he has the power to change. That he can forgive himself for what he's done in the past. And I need your help to do that.
Roathe is eating himself up inside over what he's done. And without your help, I'm worried he's just going to continue to destroy himself if he doesn't come to terms with who he is.
Roathe learned the truth about the serum. That he took it willingly. And it's destroying him. I need your help in calming him down.
Roathe is driving me insane. I don't know how to talk to him. Do you have any advice?
Non, if I were any good at speaking with that devil, do you think I would always be screaming at him in Gaullique ?
Non, if I were any good at speaking with that devil, do you think I would always be screaming at him in Gaullique ?
Pardonne-moi, I think you are on your own...
I will do what I can. For you, I will try.
Pardonne-moi, I think you are on your own...
